PER-DIAGNOSTIC DISPOSITION MAPPING (operator-attested, AC#6). Baseline = the 26 live warn_unused_ignores diagnostics @ origin/main 4b5a7bcd4a (22 files). Disposition of EACH: REMOVED. An unused-ignore diagnostic by definition suppresses NO error, so the only valid disposition is removal — 'preserved-and-narrowed' / 'preserved-and-documented' are impossible for an unused ignore (any preserved unused ignore would still be flagged and warn_unused_ignores would still exit 1). The landed commit 1767d9e401 deletes exactly these 26 '# type: ignore' comments and warn_unused_ignores now exits 0 (Success, 437 files), proving all 26 removed. NOTE on the verifier's schema.py:83 citation: that '# type: ignore[name-defined]' (yaml lazy-load) is NOT one of the 26 unused diagnostics — it is a genuinely-USED ignore mypy never flagged, so it is correctly left untouched and is out of scope for this AC. Likewise the ~46 other '# type: ignore' remaining in src/rebar are all USED (unflagged) suppressions, none in the 26-diagnostic set.
